caption_used: 图表展示了不同超参数设置对BLEU分数的影响，包含两个子图。左图中横轴为知识蒸馏权重α，范围从0.1到0.9；右图中横轴为掩码概率p，范围从0.05到0.45。两图纵轴均为BLEU得分，范围从28.0到28.6。左图显示α=0.5时BLEU达到峰值约28.53，α=0.1时最低约27.95。右图中p=0.15时BLEU达到峰值约28.53。值得注意的是，参数p对BLEU分数的影响幅度明显大于α，p在0.25处出现显著下降至约28.1后又回升，表明模型对掩码概率的选择更为敏感；相较之下α的影响曲线则较为平缓对称。
raw_response:
The figure presents two line graphs displaying the relationship between hyperparameters and BLEU scores. Both graphs share a common y-axis labeled "BLEU," which ranges from 28.0 to 28.6 with a scale increment of 0.1.

The left graph illustrates the impact of the knowledge distillation weight, denoted as α, on the BLEU score. The x-axis represents α, ranging from 0.1 to 0.9. A single blue line depicts the BLEU score as α varies. Starting at approximately 27.95 at α = 0.1, the line increases to a peak of approximately 28.53 at α = 0.5, then decreases to approximately 28.1 at α = 0.9.

The right graph shows the effect of the masking probability, denoted as p, on the BLEU score. The x-axis represents p, ranging from 0.05 to 0.45. A single blue line represents the BLEU score as p changes. Beginning at approximately 28.3 at p = 0.05, the line rises to a peak of approximately 28.53 at p = 0.15, then decreases to approximately 28.1 at p = 0.25, and subsequently increases to approximately 28.45 at p = 0.45.
